speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned a history of a painful, swollen left ankle that resolved on its own, and now you have increasing pain and swelling in your right knee. Do you also experience any fever, chills, or skin rashes?

speaker: Patient
text: No, I haven't had any fevers, chills, or rashes. I just noticed my eyes have been feeling gritty and red for a few days too. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of your joint pain, eye irritation, and urinary symptoms strongly suggests reactive arthritis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Reactive Arthritis
